verdict.rationale: xAI docs confirm a dedicated US regional endpoint (`us.api.x.ai`) for teams needing US-only request handling and inference, giving some data-residency control, plus ZDR/retention settings and per-team retention toggles. However, evidence shows only one specific region (US) documented — no EU or other region options, no broader multi-region residency selection, and no SOC2/compliance region mapping. missing for 10: multiple region options beyond US, explicit data residency/compliance documentation (EU, APAC, etc.), and independent confirmation of regional behavior.
